title: Holdout evaluation of h900 mechanism-only fallback
summary: The h900 mechanism fallback is dead code: it never fires in the current predictor because every train disease's top-20 kNN neighbors contain at least one GT drug in embeddings. Even if forced to fire, its precision is below the FILTER tier baseline.

trigger_population.description: Diseases where predict() would hit the fallback code path (`drug_scores` empty after kNN aggregation).

full_data.note: Across all 1034 diseases with GT+embeddings, every top-20 neighborhood contains GT drugs in embeddings. Fallback never fires.

holdout_seed_42.note: Also zero under 80/20 holdout split. Confirms fallback is dead code.

forced_fallback_precision_full_data.description: Evaluate what the fallback WOULD produce if it were forced to run for every disease with disease_genes.
forced_fallback_precision_full_data.interpretation: Forced fallback precision 5.96% is 35x random but only ~54% of LOW tier and 65% of FILTER tier. Median per-disease R@30 = 0% (most diseases get no hits). Not a viable tier.

root_cause_of_dead_code.reason_never_triggered: self.train_diseases (1034 entries) is built from diseases with BOTH ground_truth entries AND embeddings. Every train_disease has >=1 GT drug that is in self.embeddings. Therefore any top-20 neighbor in train_diseases contributes drugs, and drug_scores is never empty.

smoke_test_was_misleading.note: scripts/test_mechanism_fallback.py reported 'MECHANISM FALLBACK ACTIVE' for Gaucher, ALS, Huntington, Wilson, etc., but this matched sub_reason 'mechanism_specific' (h297 MECHANISM_SPECIFIC_DISEASES list) — NOT the h900 tier tags (mechanism_only_fallback / mechanism_fallback_literature_*). The test's substring match `'mechanism' in sub_reason` was too loose.
smoke_test_was_misleading.verified: Calling predict('Gaucher disease') directly returns preds with sub_reason='mechanism_specific', confirming the kNN-MinRank path ran normally (no fallback).

recommendation: Remove h900 fallback code (75 lines in src/production_predictor.py:4634-4709). It is unreachable under current configuration, adds maintenance cost, and would underperform existing tiers if somehow reached. File a new hypothesis h910 to execute the removal after a confirming code review.
